sophie_procure: Quick heads-up  QuotaGauge renewal pops in 9 days. They sent three commercial options (seat, metered, hybrid). Need a recommendation from finance + platform before I reply. Any immediate red flags?

maya_finance: Do we have the last 3mo usage to model costs? also any unpaid invoices outstanding?

alan_platform: Sharing numbers: 90d avg ~320M tokens/mo, recent peak ~680M. Traffic is mostly embeddings + nightly backfills. Current monthly bill ~ $95k.

mike_ops: Seat pitch they sent = 25 seats @ $1,800/seat -> $45k/mo but seats throttle concurrency per API key. Concern: backfills will hog seats unless vendor allows service-account whitelist.

daria_vendor: Hi team 44B Daria from QuotaGauge. Our offers: (A) Pure usage $0.00040/token with volume tiers, (B) Seats 25 @ $1,650/seat, (C) Hybrid 10 seats + overage $0.00032/token. We support SOC2, EU region, SSO. We can whitelist service accounts for seat counting on request.

legal_bot: Flag: contract auto-renew + 90-day termination notice. Data export window is 60 days. Recommend 72h security incident notif and 30-day export SLA + reciprocal indemnity cap.

maya_finance: Finance threshold is ~ $120k/mo for signoff. Pure usage at $0.00040 with our avg 320M = $128k/mo (a bit high). Hybrid could work if overage lower or committed tiers apply. Need committed tiers and monthly CSV usage report.

alan_platform: My ask: push hybrid with protective terms: 12mo, 8seats @ $1,600, overage $0.00028/token, whitelist service accounts, hourly telemetry + monthly CSV, SLA 99.9, and a cost-surge cap (monthly overage cap = 1.5x baseline). Also need KMS integration for keys.

daria_vendor: Thanks. Internally we can do: 8 seats @ $1,650 + overage $0.00030, or 6 seats @ $1,600 + $0.00028 with 10% prepay credit. KMS integration requires a small PS fee unless you commit annual prepay. We can include hourly telemetry in the package.

sophie_procure: Proposed counter I'll send: hybrid 12mo, 8 seats @ $1,600, overage $0.00028, 10% prepay credit option, whitelist service accounts, KMS included, 30-day export SLA, 48h incident notif, invoice net-45. Any objections? :thumbsup: :thinking_face:

maya_finance: +1 from finance provided net-45 ok. Make sure monthly CSV has per-route breakdown.

mike_ops: +1 from ops. Add explicit clause that internal backfills & infra keys are exempt from seat counts (whitelist).

alan_platform: +1. Also request a one-time usage credit for migration testing (50k USD) to cover spike during cutover.

daria_vendor: I'll escalate migration credit; likely doable as a one-time credit with the 12mo commit. Expect a response tomorrow.

sophie_procure: Cool. I'll send counter now and cc finance/legal/platform. Thanks everyone.
